title: Title 28 USC – Judiciary and Judicial Procedure (Tổ chức Tư pháp)

versions.text:
Title 28 – Judiciary and Judicial Procedure.
Part I: Organization of courts. Chapter 1: Supreme Court. Chapter 3: Courts of appeals. Chapter 5: District courts.
Part II: Department of Justice. Chapter 31: Attorney General.
Part IV: Jurisdiction and venue. §1331: Federal question jurisdiction. §1332: Diversity jurisdiction. §1391: Venue. §1404: Change of venue.
Part V: Procedure. §1651: Writs. §1738: Full faith and credit.
